ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows two NMOS transistors, M1 on the left and M2 on the right, with their sources tied to the bottom ground node. The left branch has a current source labeled I_bias feeding node Va. M1 has its gate and drain connected together at the Va/gate node, so M1 is diode-connected. The same gate node is also connected to the gate of M2. The right branch has M2's drain connected upward through resistor R_E to V_DD, with V_out taken at that drain-side node, and the current in the M2 branch is labeled I_x. The output is shown as an open terminal, so it is unloaded. Reasoning: Since MOS gates draw negligible DC current, the current I_bias injected into node Va must flow through diode-connected M1. Thus M1's drain current is I_bias, and this current sets M1's V_GS. M2 has the same source connection and the same gate voltage as M1, so M2 has the same V_GS. Because M1 and M2 are identical and M2 is assumed to be in saturation, M2 mirrors M1's drain current. With the output unloaded, no current is diverted at V_out, so the branch current I_x equals M2's drain current. Therefore I_x = I_bias.

method.method_draft: Apply KCL at the Va/gate node: because MOS gate currents are zero, the current supplied by the current source cannot enter the transistor gates, so it must be the drain current of the diode-connected M1: ID1 = I_bias. From the image, M1 and M2 have their gates tied together and their sources tied to ground, so VGS1 = VGS2. Since the text says the transistors are identical and M2 is in saturation, write ID1 and ID2 with the same saturation current law and conclude ID2 = ID1. The labeled current Ix is ID2, hence Ix = I_bias.

图像描述：图中左侧有一个从 VDD 供电端向下接到节点 Va 的电流源，标注为 I_bias。节点 Va 连接到 NMOS 管 M1 的上端，并且通过连线与 M1 的栅极相连，因此 M1 是二极管连接形式。M1 的源极接到底部公共地。图中 M1 和右侧 NMOS 管 M2 的栅极由同一根水平线相连，M2 的源极也接到底部公共地。M2 的漏极在右侧上方，与电阻 R_E 和输出节点 V_out 相连，旁边向下的电流箭头标注为 I_x。题目说明 M1、M2 是相同 NMOS，M2 处于饱和区，且输出端无负载。
推理：在 Va/栅极节点应用 KCL。MOS 管栅极电流近似为零，因此电流源提供的 I_bias 不能流入 M1 或 M2 的栅极，只能作为二极管连接的 M1 的漏极电流，所以 I_D1 = I_bias。由于图中 M1 和 M2 的栅极相连、源极同接地，因此 V_GS1 = V_GS2。两管相同，并且 M2 在饱和区；M1 二极管连接且导通时也满足饱和条件。因此两者在相同 V_GS 下具有相同饱和漏极电流，即 I_D2 = I_D1。图中标注的 I_x 就是 M2 的漏极电流，所以 I_x = I_D2 = I_bias。
